hardware_note: Measured on the development machine, single process, warm index, local embedding model. Absolute numbers are machine-specific; the cached/uncached ratio and the stage breakdown are the parts that generalise.

latency_ms._note: wall clock around the HTTP call, not the value in the response body: a replay reports the original computation's latency, so reading it there would quote work the caller did not wait for

by_stage_ms._note: server-side stage timings, from the uncached pass

cost.why_zero: Every model is local under the default profile, so there is nothing to bill. A zero here is a measured fact, not an absent measurement.

projection.assumption: One embedding call per uncached query over one short question. Excludes the generator, which is extractive and free on this profile, and excludes the exact cache, which repeats a previous answer for free. A hosted generative model would dominate this figure by orders of magnitude; the default path does not ship one.
